name: standard-iid-entity-reservation-20261003
purpose: Two ACTIVE metadata-only candidate reservations in the user-approved separate standard-IID/unverified-entity tier. No clinical or entity-independent generalization claims.

policy_amendment.effect: Prospective metadata-reservation scope amendment for only Mammographic Mass and Haberman. Not retroactive clearance of the previous stricter-tier decisions or measured cohorts.
policy_amendment.relaxed_condition: Verified patient/entity mapping is not required for this explicitly limited standard-public-IID tier.
unchanged_conditions: Primary permissive data rights and all existing restrictions.
Native targets, reviewed exclusions and no target/test-data leakage.
Rows200-50000, <=200predictors and >=60records per class in source metadata.
Do not discard known group IDs, documented repeat-entity links or mandatory temporal boundaries.
No models, payload acquisition, algorithm freeze or confirmation release authorized by this reservation.

datasets.name: haberman-survival

claim_boundary.claim_scope: Row-level standard public IID benchmark evidence only, under explicitly unresolved patient/entity mapping.
claim_boundary.limits: This is not a waiver for known repeat-entity or temporal leakage. If later evidence identifies available group IDs, repeated-entity links or mandatory temporal boundaries, stop and review; do not drop or ignore them to preserve IID eligibility.

datasets.prediction_time: Retrospective postsurgical five-year survival-status classification. Preserve age at operation, operation year and positive axillary-node count. Status1 means survived five years or longer; status2 means died within five years. This is not a preoperative prognostic model, alternative time horizon or censoring-adjusted survival analysis.
datasets.unresolved_entity_mapping: The source describes surgical patient cases but does not verify a one-patient/one-index-operation mapping. Operation year remains a descriptive predictor, not proof of temporal generalization or a supplied longitudinal group index.
datasets.schema_review_notes: The three original native UCI predictors remain numerical with their original meanings. No label transformation, patient ID inference or outcome-history feature is added.

rights.approval_basis: Reverified explicit original UCI dataset grant. This tier amendment changes permissible benchmark claim scope only; it does not alter licensing or expand deployment/sharing permission.
rights.scope: Metadata reservation only now; later local scientific benchmark processing requires explicit restricted-tier freeze/release. No hosted row sharing, reidentification, clinical use or additional redistribution permission.
rights.obligations: Credit original contributors/UCI, retain license notices and prominently disclose unresolved entity mapping and retrospective endpoint limits.

source.payload_integrity_status: Not acquired; no actual payload checksum or row-level duplicate/split checks have been performed.

claim_boundary.limits: This is not a waiver for known repeat-entity or temporal leakage. If later evidence identifies available group IDs, repeated-entity links or mandatory temporal boundaries, stop and review; do not drop or ignore them to preserve IID eligibility.

datasets.prediction_time: Retrospective benign/malignant mass-lesion annotation using Age, Shape, Margin and Density. Primary source explicitly marks the radiologist BI-RADS assessment non-predictive; it is excluded. No prospective cancer-onset, independent-patient diagnostic performance or clinical deployment claim.
datasets.unresolved_entity_mapping: The source counts961 masses, not verified961 distinct patients. Lesion-to-patient and repeated-mass mapping remain unavailable; the new tier does not resolve or certify that mapping.
datasets.schema_review_notes: Primary variable notes call Shape and Margin nominal despite integer storage; Density remains its original ordinal code and Age numeric. BI-RADS is excluded, not imputed as a feature or used as a predictor.
